incidents.name: USDTStakingContract28 public tokenAllowAll()
incidents.notes: tokenAllowAll(token, spender) was public with no owner check, so the attacker had the staking contract approve them for unlimited USDT and then transferred out the whole deposit balance.

sources.ref: onchain review: USDTStakingContract28 0x800cfD4A2ba8CE93eA2cc814Fce26c3635169017 created 2023-07-11T12:53:59Z by 0xdcbeefb14ba39092711d62cf3ea19af643f2c155, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment - 316,860 seconds (3.7 days). Loss read from the tx receipt: 20,999.92 USDT (USD-pegged at 1:1).
